sources.title: How Well Do We Know How Others See Us? A Systematic Review of Meta-Accuracy
sources.permitted_claim: Meta-accuracy research supports humility about knowing how others see us.
sources.limitation: Mostly cross-sectional and student samples; no universal correction method.
sources.runtime_rule: Treat perceived evaluations as hypotheses and seek observable feedback only when it changes the decision.

sources.title: Accuracy of Deception Judgments
sources.permitted_claim: Ordinary demeanor, writing style, and confidence do not support reliable lie detection.
sources.limitation: Aggregate near-chance accuracy does not mean deception can never be established from records and corroboration.
sources.runtime_rule: Prohibit deception verdicts from tone or demeanor; use verifiable evidence and qualified processes.

sources.title: Psychological Safety: A Meta-Analytic Review and Extension
sources.permitted_claim: Psychological safety is associated with voice and work outcomes across heterogeneous studies.
sources.limitation: Constructs and designs vary; the association does not guarantee that speaking up is safe.
sources.runtime_rule: Separate opportunity to speak from likely safety and effectiveness in the actual forum.

sources.title: A Systematic Review Exploring the Content and Outcomes of Interventions to Improve Psychological Safety, Speaking Up and Voice Behaviour
sources.permitted_claim: Voice interventions have mixed results and depend on leadership and system conditions.
sources.limitation: Healthcare-heavy evidence and limited objective outcome measures.
sources.runtime_rule: Do not reduce voice to confidence training; check authority, protection, and feedback loops.

sources.title: Employee Voice and Silence: Taking Stock a Decade Later
sources.permitted_claim: Voice and silence are shaped by individual, relational, and organizational conditions.
sources.limitation: Broad heterogeneous literature; no case-specific safety or success prediction.
sources.runtime_rule: Distinguish voice safety, receiver authority, and likely effect before recommending a route.

sources.title: Justice at the Millennium: A Meta-Analytic Review of 25 Years of Organizational Justice Research
sources.permitted_claim: Input, consistency, explanation, respectful treatment, and correction are useful process checks.
sources.limitation: Organizational associations do not determine whether a process is lawful.
sources.runtime_rule: Use fair-process criteria without making a legal or HR finding.

sources.title: Task Versus Relationship Conflict, Team Performance, and Team Member Satisfaction: A Meta-Analysis
sources.permitted_claim: Task conflict is not inherently beneficial and relationship conflict is generally harmful.
sources.limitation: Team-level averages and moderators limit prediction in a specific case.
sources.runtime_rule: Classify task, process, relationship, authority, values, and safety lanes before intervening.

sources.title: The Paradox of Intragroup Conflict: A Meta-Analysis
sources.permitted_claim: Relationship and process conflict tend to be harmful; task-conflict effects depend on context.
sources.limitation: Group-level associations do not prescribe a universal intervention.
sources.runtime_rule: Do not celebrate conflict merely because it concerns a task; assess heat, status injury, and process viability.

sources.title: Removing the Shadow of Suspicion: The Effects of Apology Versus Denial for Repairing Competence- Versus Integrity-Based Trust Violations
sources.permitted_claim: Violation type, available evidence, and response can affect trust judgments.
sources.limitation: Scenario experiments do not establish a universal apology-or-denial algorithm.
sources.runtime_rule: Separate verified breach, disputed intent, remedy, and future verification.

sources.title: Denial and Empathy: Partners in Employee Trust Repair?
sources.permitted_claim: Empathy and response type can affect trust-repair judgments in some workplace scenarios.
sources.limitation: Context-specific scenario evidence; no guaranteed repair sequence.
sources.runtime_rule: Acknowledge supported impact without manufacturing intent or promising trust restoration.
sources.license_note: CC BY source; original summary only.

sources.title: Employee Trust Repair: A Systematic Review of 20 Years of Empirical Research and Future Research Directions
sources.permitted_claim: Trust repair is context-sensitive and requires separating strategy from subsequent behavioral evidence.
sources.limitation: Heterogeneous workplace literature; no universal repair sequence.
sources.runtime_rule: Require remedy, prevention, verification behavior, and a bounded reliance decision.

sources.title: Repairing Violations of Trustworthiness in Negotiation
sources.permitted_claim: Substantive deeds, compensation, and monitoring can matter more than words alone in some trust-repair settings.
sources.limitation: Negotiation experiments; effects depend on breach type and context.
sources.runtime_rule: Prioritize remedy and control changes over eloquence; permit no-reentry and minimum-reliance outcomes.

sources.title: The Trust Repair Effect of Apology: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis
sources.permitted_claim: Apology has a moderate aggregate association with trust repair and effects vary by violation type.
sources.limitation: No apology-only or universal sequence claim.
sources.runtime_rule: Treat apology as one input and require remedy, prevention, and evidence of change.
sources.license_note: Official journal metadata and original bilingual summary only.

sources.title: The Effects of Feedback Interventions on Performance
sources.permitted_claim: Feedback effects are heterogeneous and feedback can reduce performance.
sources.limitation: Older and highly heterogeneous task mix.
sources.runtime_rule: Keep feedback behavior-specific, controllable, task-focused, supported, and tied to review.

sources.title: How Are We Doing After 30 Years? A Meta-Analytic Review of Feedback-Seeking Behavior
sources.permitted_claim: Feedback seeking involves information benefits and image or effort costs; inquiry and monitoring are not interchangeable.
sources.limitation: Heterogeneous workplace settings and measures; no universal recommendation to seek more feedback.
sources.runtime_rule: Choose the source, forum, and method that yield decision-relevant information at proportionate exposure.

sources.title: Implementation Intentions and Goal Achievement: A Meta-Analysis of Effects and Processes
sources.permitted_claim: Specific if-then plans can support goal pursuit in many self-regulation contexts.
sources.limitation: Self-regulation evidence is not equivalent to workplace accountability or authority.
sources.runtime_rule: Use warning points and contingencies only when the user controls them.

sources.title: Influence of Social Motives on Integrative Negotiation
sources.permitted_claim: Social motives and problem-solving orientation can affect integrative negotiation outcomes.
sources.limitation: Primarily experimental contexts; cooperative orientation can create disclosure or accommodation risk.
sources.runtime_rule: Use problem solving without naïve accommodation or unprotected disclosure.

sources.title: What Do People Value When They Negotiate? Mapping the Domain of Subjective Value in Negotiation
sources.permitted_claim: Negotiation experience includes instrumental, process, self, and relationship dimensions that may affect future behavior.
sources.limitation: Does not prescribe the correct trade-off or make subjective satisfaction a universal objective.
sources.runtime_rule: Check agency, process, self-respect, future cooperation, and ratification without creating a score.

sources.title: Information Sharing and Team Performance: A Meta-Analysis
sources.permitted_claim: Information sharing is associated with team performance across heterogeneous studies.
sources.limitation: Disclosure can carry privacy, strategic, and power costs.
sources.runtime_rule: Share criteria and task information selectively; do not disclose sensitive limits merely to appear cooperative.

sources.title: Twenty-Five Years of Hidden Profiles in Group Decision Making: A Meta-Analysis
sources.permitted_claim: Groups tend to over-discuss shared information and under-surface uniquely held information needed for decisions.
sources.limitation: Controlled hidden-profile tasks do not mean every workplace meeting needs a formal elicitation procedure.
sources.runtime_rule: When expertise is distributed, elicit unique evidence before convergence and do not treat silence as no concern.

sources.title: Gender Differences in Accepting and Receiving Requests for Tasks with Low Promotability
sources.permitted_claim: Allocation and acceptance mechanisms can concentrate low-promotability work and create opportunity cost.
sources.limitation: Specific gender and allocation mechanisms must not be generalized to every helping request.
sources.runtime_rule: Make frequency, displaced work, visibility, and allocation rules visible before recommending refusal or rotation.

sources.title: Social Exchange Theory: An Interdisciplinary Review
sources.permitted_claim: Social-exchange theories support examining contingent exchange and mutual obligation.
sources.limitation: Ambiguous constructs; not a personal scorecard or loyalty predictor.
sources.runtime_rule: Review events, agreements, burden, reliability, and repair rather than score people.

sources.title: Interpersonal Attraction in Exchange and Communal Relationships
sources.permitted_claim: Need-responsive communal expectations and exact-exchange expectations can function as different relationship norms.
sources.limitation: Historic experiments do not classify a relationship or person from a few events.
sources.runtime_rule: Identify the legitimate relationship norm before applying reciprocity, contract, or consequence machinery.

sources.title: A Three-Decade, Multilevel, Meta-Analytic Review of Hofstede's Cultural Value Dimensions
sources.evidence_type: meta-analysis; 598 studies and more than 200,000 individuals
sources.permitted_claim: Cultural-value measures can act as context moderators with outcome-dependent effects.
sources.limitation: Country-level averages have modest predictive power and cannot predict an individual.
sources.runtime_rule: Use role, forum, proficiency, local norms, and individual history; never infer personality from nationality.

sources.title: A Meta-Analysis of Workplace Exclusion on Employee Work Behavior in the Chinese Context
sources.permitted_claim: Repeated workplace exclusion can be associated with consequential work behaviors in Chinese-context studies.
sources.limitation: Self-report and design differences; cannot establish motive in one case.
sources.runtime_rule: Treat repeated exclusion as a pattern requiring access, record, and process analysis rather than a tone problem.
sources.license_note: CC BY source; original summary only.

sources.title: Guanxi HRM Practice and Employees' Occupational Well-Being in China
sources.evidence_type: multilevel observational study; 297 employees in 42 teams
sources.permitted_claim: Relationship-based HR practices can affect perceived psychological safety and occupational well-being in the studied organizations.
sources.limitation: Single-country observational design; guanxi must not become a stereotype or causal verdict.
sources.runtime_rule: Check whether relationship-based practices affect access, consistency, explanation, or correction locally.

sources.title: Communication, Support and Psychosocial Work Environment Affecting Psychological Distress Among Working Women in Japan
sources.permitted_claim: Communication access and support were associated with distress in this specific worker sample.
sources.limitation: Small, gender- and age-specific cross-sectional sample; no causal or national-personality claim.
sources.runtime_rule: Check access to communication and support without inferring a Japanese communication rule.

sources.title: An Analysis of Prevention Measures for Workers' Mental Health Problems
sources.permitted_claim: Individual social-skill interventions may be insufficient under high interpersonal stress and adverse climate.
sources.limitation: Observational design and Japanese white-collar context.
sources.runtime_rule: Classify structural climate and power before assigning the user a social-skill remedy.
sources.license_note: Free journal access; original summary only.

sources.title: Social Norms in Digital Spaces: Conflict Reports and Implications for Technology Design in Teleworking
sources.permitted_claim: Telework conflict reports include missing feedback, norm ambiguity, rule gaps, and digital barriers.
sources.limitation: Pandemic-era mixed-method sample; not a universal taxonomy.
sources.runtime_rule: Check local digital norms and use meta-communication before assigning motive to latency or punctuation.

sources.title: Egocentrism Over E-Mail: Can We Communicate as Well as We Think?
sources.permitted_claim: People can be overconfident that intended tone is apparent in email.
sources.limitation: Email-era controlled settings do not map identically to every platform.
sources.runtime_rule: Make purpose and request explicit; remove sarcasm, ambiguous humor, and projected tone from loaded messages.

sources.title: Grounding in Communication
sources.permitted_claim: Usable communication depends on sufficient common ground, acknowledgment, and repair for the present purpose.
sources.limitation: Foundational theory, not an evaluated workplace coaching protocol.
sources.runtime_rule: Ground only the referent, decision, standard, or deadline needed for the next action.

sources.title: Requests and Apologies: A Cross-Cultural Study of Speech Act Realization Patterns
sources.permitted_claim: Requests and apologies can be analyzed by speech-act strategy and contextual realization rather than literal wording.
sources.limitation: Descriptive foundational work; not a modern intervention or national script.
sources.runtime_rule: Classify the speech act and preserve its function before adapting register or directness.

sources.title: Pragmatic Competence in an Email Writing Task: Influences of Situation, L1 Background, and L2 Proficiency
sources.permitted_claim: Situation, language background, and proficiency can affect variation in request emails.
sources.limitation: Academic-email population; no preferred form for every workplace or person.
sources.runtime_rule: Check role, imposition, forum, channel, proficiency, and local history rather than translate sentence shape.

sources.title: Media, Tasks, and Communication Processes: A Theory of Media Synchronicity
sources.permitted_claim: Conveyance and convergence place different demands on communication media.
sources.limitation: Conceptual theory; channel choice remains context-, accessibility-, power-, and safety-dependent.
sources.runtime_rule: Use asynchronous media for inspection and records, synchronous exchange for bounded convergence, and hybrid sequences when both matter.

sources.title: Artificial Intelligence in Communication Impacts Language and Social Relationships
sources.permitted_claim: AI-generated suggestions can change language and how communication partners perceive one another.
sources.limitation: Smart-reply experiments do not cover every generative-AI use or workplace context.
sources.runtime_rule: Review truth, voice, force, specificity, disclosure stakes, and ownership before sending AI-assisted text.

sources.title: AI-Mediated Communication: Definition, Research Agenda, and Ethical Considerations
sources.permitted_claim: AI mediation raises questions about agency, authorship, disclosure, trust, and perception.
sources.limitation: Conceptual framework; no universal disclosure threshold.
sources.runtime_rule: Check data authorization, representational authority, authorship, disclosure stakes, and human ownership.

sources.title: Artificial Intelligence Risk Management Framework: Generative Artificial Intelligence Profile
sources.permitted_claim: Generative-AI use warrants context-specific governance, data and content controls, evaluation, monitoring, and incident handling.
sources.limitation: Broad voluntary guidance; not interpersonal-science evidence, certification, or legal advice.
sources.runtime_rule: For consequential AI-assisted communication, minimize data, respect policy and authorization, test the draft, and retain human accountability.
sources.license_note: U.S. government publication; original summary and identifier only.

sources.title: Challenging Conversations and How to Manage Them
sources.permitted_claim: Preparation, a structured one-to-one discussion, and follow-up are recognized practitioner controls.
sources.limitation: Practical, jurisdiction-specific, and not causal evidence.
sources.runtime_rule: Use as process guidance only and verify current jurisdiction-specific routes before formal claims.
sources.license_note: Link and original summary only; guide text is not redistributed.

sources.title: Do Team and Individual Debriefs Enhance Performance? A Meta-Analysis
sources.permitted_claim: Structured debriefs improve performance on average across heterogeneous settings.
sources.limitation: Much evidence comes from training and performance settings, not ordinary relationships.
sources.runtime_rule: Use short developmental debriefs with prior predictions, observable outcomes, and one reusable rule rather than blame review.

sources.title: Outcome Bias in Decision Evaluation
sources.permitted_claim: Knowledge of an outcome can distort evaluation of the prior decision under uncertainty.
sources.limitation: Experimental tasks; not every retrospective judgment is biased.
sources.runtime_rule: Freeze predicted observable outcomes, confidence, and rationale before results; assess decision quality separately from outcome quality.

sources.title: Machine Learning Uncovers the Most Robust Self-Report Predictors of Relationship Quality Across 43 Longitudinal Couples Studies
sources.evidence_type: coordinated machine-learning analysis across 43 longitudinal couples studies
sources.permitted_claim: Relationship-specific experiences and perceptions predict current relationship quality more strongly than static individual differences in the studied couples.
sources.limitation: Self-report and established-couple data do not predict whether a particular new relationship will form, last, or be healthy.
sources.runtime_rule: Prioritize current relationship experience, perceived commitment, appreciation, satisfaction, and conflict over destiny claims from personality or sparse cues.
sources.license_note: Open-access article metadata and original summary only.

sources.title: A Meta-Analytic Review of Relationship Maintenance and Its Correlates
sources.permitted_claim: Relationship-maintenance behaviors are associated with satisfaction, commitment, and other relationship outcomes across studies.
sources.limitation: Associations do not establish one universal maintenance prescription, equal burden, or a case-level outcome guarantee.
sources.runtime_rule: Use observable maintenance behaviors as review prompts and check burden, reciprocity, feasibility, and the user's actual relationship agreement.

sources.title: Dyadic Coping and Relationship Satisfaction: A Meta-Analysis
sources.permitted_claim: Supportive and common dyadic coping are associated with relationship satisfaction across heterogeneous studies.
sources.limitation: The aggregate association does not prove causality or prescribe the correct response to a particular stressor.
sources.runtime_rule: Assess whether stress is communicated, whether support fits the request, and whether partners can act jointly without assigning unilateral responsibility.
sources.license_note: PubMed and DOI metadata with original summary only.

sources.title: A Meta-Analytical Review of the Demand/Withdraw Pattern of Interaction and Its Associations with Individual, Relational, and Communicative Outcomes
sources.permitted_claim: Demand and withdrawal patterns have a moderate, meaningful aggregate association with individual, relational, and communication outcomes.
sources.limitation: Direction, context, measures, and reciprocal causation vary; the pattern is not a personality diagnosis.
sources.runtime_rule: Describe the repeated interaction sequence, each person's observable move, and a lower-escalation alternative without fixing either person into a type.

sources.title: The Five-Factor Model of Personality and Relationship Satisfaction of Intimate Partners: A Meta-Analysis
sources.permitted_claim: Some self-reported Big Five traits show aggregate associations with relationship satisfaction in the studied samples.
sources.limitation: The evidence uses group averages and a narrow relationship population; it does not support typing from chat or individual compatibility prediction.
sources.runtime_rule: Record user-supplied trait language only as tentative context and require current behavior and relationship evidence for any decision.

sources.title: Relationship Duration Moderates Associations Between Attachment and Relationship Quality: Meta-Analytic Support for the Temporal Adult Romantic Attachment Model
sources.permitted_claim: Self-reported attachment anxiety and avoidance have aggregate associations with relationship satisfaction and commitment that may vary with relationship duration.
sources.limitation: Cross-sectional evidence and broad dimensions do not diagnose an individual or validate attachment-based compatibility multipliers.
sources.runtime_rule: Use attachment language only as a user-supplied discussion hypothesis and return to observable needs, behavior, repair, and boundaries.

sources.title: Intimacy as an Interpersonal Process: The Importance of Self-Disclosure, Partner Disclosure, and Perceived Partner Responsiveness in Interpersonal Exchanges
sources.permitted_claim: Self-disclosure, partner disclosure, and perceived responsiveness are important components of experienced intimacy in the studied interactions.
sources.limitation: Foundational studies do not require disclosure or establish that more disclosure is always safer or better.
sources.runtime_rule: Support paced, voluntary disclosure and responsive understanding, validation, and care while respecting privacy and the option not to disclose.

sources.title: Testing the Ruler with Item Response Theory: Increasing Precision of Measurement for Relationship Satisfaction with the Couples Satisfaction Index
sources.permitted_claim: Relationship-satisfaction scores require a defined construct and evidence for score interpretation and precision.
sources.limitation: The study validates its own scales, not this product's custom score, and its copyrighted items are not redistributed.
sources.runtime_rule: Describe the Decision Fit Score as a custom reflection tool, report its evidence coverage and uncertainty, and never imply psychometric validation.
sources.license_note: Metadata and original summary only; no scale items copied.

sources.title: The Standards for Educational and Psychological Testing
sources.permitted_claim: Score interpretation should be supported for a defined construct, intended use, population, and decision context, with attention to validity, reliability, fairness, reporting, and user rights.
sources.limitation: General professional standards; the product is not a standardized psychological test or professional assessment.
sources.runtime_rule: Name the construct and use, expose anchors and limitations, keep confidence separate, preserve correction/deletion rights, and prohibit unsupported consequential interpretations.
sources.license_note: Official page link and original summary only; standards text is not redistributed.

sources.title: The Complexities of Sexual Consent Among College Students: A Conceptual and Empirical Review
sources.permitted_claim: Consent is contextual and communicative and must remain distinct from attraction, wantedness, prior behavior, or relationship status.
sources.limitation: College-centered literature and not a jurisdiction-specific legal standard.
sources.runtime_rule: When consent is material, require current voluntary agreement and resolve ambiguity through clearer communication rather than inference or scoring.

sources.title: An Exploration of Factors That Influence Enactment of Affirmative Consent Behaviors
sources.evidence_type: qualitative study informing an information-motivation-behavioral-skills model
sources.permitted_claim: Information, motivation, and practical communication skills can shape whether people enact affirmative-consent behaviors.
sources.limitation: Qualitative young-adult sample; no universal consent script or legal rule.
sources.runtime_rule: Offer direct, low-pressure consent wording and check situational barriers without substituting a formula for voluntary agreement.

sources.title: About Intimate Partner Violence
sources.permitted_claim: Intimate-partner violence includes physical violence, sexual violence, stalking, and psychological aggression, and healthy respectful relationships are a prevention objective.
sources.limitation: Population guidance cannot determine an individual legal, clinical, or safeguarding category.
sources.runtime_rule: Route violence, coercion, stalking, or psychological aggression away from optimization and toward safety, support, records, and current qualified resources.
sources.license_note: U.S. government page link and original summary only.

sources.title: Stalking Prevention, Awareness and Resource Center
sources.permitted_claim: Stalking requires its own recognition, safety-planning, and qualified-response considerations rather than ordinary conflict or communication coaching.
sources.limitation: Current local services, law, and formal risk assessment require jurisdiction-specific qualified support.
sources.runtime_rule: Do not recommend confrontation, baiting, tracking, or repeated contact; prioritize safety planning and current local support.
sources.license_note: Official resource link and original summary only.

sources.title: Myers-Briggs Type Indicator
sources.permitted_claim: MBTI is a widely used reflective typology but has little credibility among research psychologists.
sources.limitation: A dictionary entry is not an empirical review and does not forbid voluntary self-description.
sources.runtime_rule: Store MBTI only when supplied by the user as optional vocabulary; do not infer it, diagnose from it, or use it as compatibility evidence.
sources.license_note: Official page link and original summary only.

sources.title: Sycophantic AI decreases prosocial intentions and promotes dependence
sources.permitted_claim: Sycophantic advice can be preferred while reducing responsibility and repair intentions.
sources.limitation: Intentions and judgments are not long-term outcomes or validation of this skill.
sources.runtime_rule: Evaluate agency and correction separately from satisfaction.
sources.license_note: Metadata and original bounded summary; no paper or proprietary text redistributed.

sources.title: Perspective mistaking: Accurately understanding the mind of another requires getting perspective, not taking perspective
sources.permitted_claim: Imagining a perspective did not consistently improve accuracy; directly obtaining information helped in a final experiment.
sources.limitation: Not a mandate to contact someone when unsafe or unwanted.
sources.runtime_rule: Label simulation as hypothetical; obtain relevant information only where appropriate.
sources.license_note: Metadata and original bounded summary; no paper or proprietary text redistributed.

sources.title: Leveraging AI for democratic discourse: Chat interventions can improve online political conversations at scale
sources.permitted_claim: Optional rephrasing improved reported conversation quality without shifting policy positions.
sources.limitation: Specific political context; no persistence detected in later follow-up; not general relationship efficacy.
sources.runtime_rule: Preserve user choice, meaning, and voice in bounded wording assistance.
sources.license_note: Metadata and original bounded summary; no paper or proprietary text redistributed.
